REDIS_LIMIT_LEARNED: Never let staging/CI share production Redis. Upstash free tier = 500K commands/month PER DATABASE. The whole-tapir primary hit 500K from 15h of staging server usage (BRPOP loop + SSE + health checks + 32 builds). creative-finch worker unaffected (1 key, 0B). Lesson: (1) Staging must use its own Redis instance. (2) app.json must NOT provision redis for CI test runs. (3) Add REDIS_COMMAND_COUNT env var monitoring. (4) Add auto-shutdown when 90% threshold reached. (5) REO-1 polling reduction was correct but too late. (6) Emergency error handler prevents server crash when limit hit.

CI_DYNO_LEARNED: Heroku CI does NOT support Eco dynos. app.json test formation must use standard-1x minimum. The platform capability detection (dyno-manager.mjs detect) correctly identifies this. Lesson: (1) Always run 'node scripts/dyno-manager.mjs detect' before CI setup. (2) Test formation size must be standard-1x not eco. (3) CI test runs must NOT provision Redis (removed from addons).

QSTASH_CONFIGURED: QStash message queue credentials pushed to Heroku staging config vars. QStash replaces Redis BRPOP polling (monitor-worker, hermes-worker) with push-based message delivery. Eliminates remaining Redis command consumption from worker polling loops. Tokens stored securely in Heroku config vars — never committed to git.

LIMIT_GATES_SET: All Upstash free tier products monitored. creative-finch 18K/500K (3.6%), obliging-shad 0/100K (0%), QStash pending. Warning thresholds at 50%, block at 90%. CI disabled from all Redis. app.json removes Redis from test. Lesson: Never let CI touch production or staging Redis. Use ephemeral databases for CI if needed.
